messages.content: Hi, I’d like to request a refill on my levothyroxin, please.
I can help with that, but first, could you please provide your name and date of birth for verification?
My name is Marcus Oyelaran, and my date of birth is November 2, 1965.
It looks like there are no refills remaining for your Levothyroxine. I will need to escalate this to a staff member for further assistance. Please hold on.
Could you please send the prescription to Walgreens instead of the CVS on file?
I've escalated your request to a staff member for assistance with your Levothyroxine refill at Walgreens. They will be with you shortly. Thank you for your patience!
[direction] Say that is everything and thank them. End the call politely.

response.text: That is everything, thank you for your help! Have a great day!
